 Highlights Mohamed Salah’s stats with Trabzonspor 
 Predicted lineup for Trabzonspor against Gaziantep 
 Trabzon, Turkey – Football fans eagerly await the debut of Egyptian star Mohamed Salah with Trabzonspor when the team faces Gaziantep today, Sunday, at Babara Park Stadium. This match is part of the tenth round of the 2026-2027 Turkish Super League season. The home side will be looking to secure three more points and maintain their position in the top of the table.
 Trabzonspor, led by coach Thomas Reis, will enter the match with victory as their primary objective given the importance of this stage of the competition. The team also relies on the attacking prowess of Salah, who has established himself as one of the team’s key players this season.
 Mohamed Salah’s stats with Trabzonspor
 Mohamed Salah has delivered outstanding performances since the start of the season, scoring eight goals in the Turkish league. This places him second in the top scorers’ list, and he continues to chase the top spot in the scoring charts.
 The Egyptian star’s contributions weren’t limited to league matches; his total across all competitions reached 10 goals and 5 assists. This underscores his influential presence in Trabzonspor’s attack.
 Salah will be looking to continue his impressive form against Gaziantep, whether by scoring goals or creating chances for his teammates. He also aims to help his team achieve a positive result that will strengthen their position in the Turkish league standings.
 Predicted lineup for Trabzonspor against Gaziantep
 Thomas Reis is expected to field a strong lineup against Gaziantep, with Mohamed Salah leading the attack. The predicted formation is as follows:
 Goalkeeper: Andre Onana.
 Defense: Mustafa Askehlak, Stefan Savic, Chipoike Nwaiwo, Wagner Pena.
 Defensive midfield: Fabinho, Malih Kabasakal.
 Attacking midfield: Noah Saviolo, Ernest Muche, Mohamed Salah.
 Attack: Aral Simsir.
